Reference / testing/check

testing/check#

Checks for tests beyond test.is and test.ok: floats, text and sequence diffs, regexes, and conditions that become true later.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

test "totals" {
    CloseTo(actual: total, expected: 10.0, relative: 1e-9, absolute: 0.0).check();
    TextEquals(actual: rendered, expected: expected).check();      // shows a diff
    SequenceEquals(actual: ids, expected: [1, 2, 3]).check();
    MatchingRegex(origin: id, pattern: Regex("^[a-f0-9]{32}$")).check();
}
async test "ready" {
    await Eventually(condition: () is bool { server.ready(); }, clock: SystemClock(),
        timeout: Duration(seconds: 2.rat()), interval: Duration(seconds: rat(20, 1000))).check();
}

Description#

Checks for tests beyond test.is and test.ok: floats, text and sequence diffs, regexes, and conditions that become true later.

A check fails the running test with a message; it may only run inside one.

object Eventually#

object Eventually does AsyncChecking

Eventually.Eventually#

Tries condition every interval until timeout, on clock; InvalidCheck for a negative timeout or a zero interval.
